quests.question: I haven't seen my cousins ___ they moved to another city.
quests.hint: The move marks the starting point of a period without seeing them.
quests.explanation: 'Since' introduces the starting point of a period that continues to now — the move began the time apart.

quests.question: Call me ___ you land at the airport.
quests.hint: The call should happen immediately, with no delay after landing.
quests.explanation: 'As soon as' means immediately after — the call should follow landing without delay.

quests.question: The math problem looked impossible, ___ she solved it in minutes.
quests.hint: An unexpected, impressive outcome follows a difficult setup.
quests.explanation: 'Yet' shows surprising contrast — a problem that looked impossible was still solved quickly.

quests.question: She has neither the time ___ the energy to redecorate the house.
quests.hint: 'Neither' always pairs with one exact word to exclude two things.
quests.explanation: 'Neither...nor' rules out both items together — she lacks both time and energy.

quests.question: I'll finish the marathon ___ it takes me six hours.
quests.hint: Finishing is guaranteed no matter how long it takes.
quests.explanation: 'Even if' shows the result stays the same regardless of a possible condition — finishing is certain either way.

quests.question: Our flight was delayed ___ a storm was approaching the airport.
quests.hint: A specific weather event explains the delay.
quests.explanation: 'Because' introduces the direct reason for the delay — the approaching storm.

quests.question: ___ the flight ___ the hotel were booked through the same website.
quests.hint: Two travel bookings share one connecting pair — inclusion, not choice or exclusion.
quests.explanation: 'Both...and' includes two items together — the flight and the hotel were booked the same way.

quests.question: The window seat gives you a view, ___ the aisle seat gives you easy access.
quests.hint: Two seat types are being compared, each with its own advantage.
quests.explanation: 'While' contrasts two related facts — one seat offers a view, the other offers convenience.

quests.question: You'll need a visa ___ you're staying longer than ninety days.
quests.hint: The visa requirement depends on the length of the stay.
quests.explanation: 'If' introduces the condition that triggers the visa requirement — staying past ninety days.

quests.question: The crowd cheered ___ the runners crossed the finish line.
quests.hint: Two things happened together, at the very same moment.
quests.explanation: 'As' can show two events happening at the same time — the cheering and the finishing happened together.

quests.question: The store was having a huge sale, ___ I bought two jackets.
quests.hint: The sale directly influenced the shopping decision.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the big sale led to buying more items.

quests.question: You can't return the item ___ you have the receipt.
quests.hint: The receipt is the one requirement for a return.
quests.explanation: 'Unless' means 'except if' — a return depends on having this one document.

quests.question: The new phone not only runs faster ___ also has a better camera.
quests.hint: 'Not only' always pairs with one specific word to add an extra positive point.
quests.explanation: 'Not only...but also' adds a second impressive feature to the first — speed and camera quality.

quests.question: The video wouldn't load ___ my internet connection was too slow.
quests.hint: A slow connection explains the loading problem.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the direct reason for a problem — the slow connection caused the loading issue.

quests.question: You can use the free version, ___ you can upgrade for extra features.
quests.hint: Two account options are offered — only one applies at a time.
quests.explanation: 'Or' presents two alternatives — staying with the free version, or upgrading for more features.

quests.question: Employees receive a bonus ___ they meet their yearly targets.
quests.hint: The bonus is tied to a specific achievement.
quests.explanation: 'When' introduces the situation that triggers the bonus — reaching yearly targets.

quests.question: Send the report to your manager ___ you leave the office.
quests.hint: One task should be finished ahead of leaving.
quests.explanation: 'Before' places sending the report earlier in time than leaving.

quests.question: She answered emails ___ prepared the meeting notes all morning.
quests.hint: Two separate tasks were both completed during the same morning.
quests.explanation: 'And' links two tasks the same person completed — answering emails and preparing notes.

quests.question: ___ the medicine tasted awful, it worked quickly.
quests.hint: A bad quality is acknowledged, but the result was still positive.
quests.explanation: 'Although' introduces a concession — despite the bad taste, the medicine was effective.

quests.question: He has felt much better ___ he started jogging every morning.
quests.hint: Starting a new habit marks the beginning of an ongoing change.
quests.explanation: 'Since' marks the starting point of a change that continues now — jogging began the improvement.

quests.question: Keep a bottle of water nearby ___ you get thirsty during the workout.
quests.hint: You're preparing for something that might happen, not something guaranteed.
quests.explanation: 'In case' introduces a precaution for a possible situation — the water is ready if thirst happens.

quests.question: ___ you take the medicine now, ___ the fever will get worse.
quests.hint: One action prevents a worsening outcome — two alternative paths are presented.
quests.explanation: 'Either...or' presents two alternative outcomes — taking the medicine now, or facing a worse fever.

quests.question: Grandpa tells the same stories every year ___ we always laugh at them.
quests.hint: Our reaction is the reason he keeps repeating the stories.
quests.explanation: 'Because' gives the reason behind a habit — our laughter is why he repeats the stories.

quests.question: We can celebrate at home ___ book a table at a restaurant.
quests.hint: Two celebration options are offered — only one will be chosen.
quests.explanation: 'Or' presents two alternatives — the family will choose one way to celebrate.

quests.question: She knits ___ she watches her favorite shows.
quests.hint: Two activities happen together, filling the same block of time.
quests.explanation: 'While' shows two actions occurring at the same time — knitting and watching happen together.

quests.question: We'll miss the opening scene ___ we don't leave for the cinema now.
quests.hint: Missing the scene depends on one condition: leaving late.
quests.explanation: 'If' introduces the condition — missing the opening depends on a late departure.

quests.question: The concert tickets sold out fast, ___ we bought ours a month early.
quests.hint: Fast selling directly explains an early decision.
quests.explanation: 'So' introduces a result — the fast-selling tickets led to buying early.

quests.question: ___ you practice, ___ better you get.
quests.hint: This pattern matches one increasing degree to another, in parallel.
quests.explanation: 'The...the' compares two increasing degrees — more practice leads to more improvement.

quests.question: The neighborhood feels safer ___ a new streetlight was installed.
quests.hint: A specific change explains the improved feeling.
quests.explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for a change — the new streetlight is why it feels safer.

quests.question: Volunteers gather at the park ___ the cleanup event is announced.
quests.hint: Gathering happens at one specific, triggered moment.
quests.explanation: 'When' introduces the exact time volunteers gather — right after the announcement.
